subject.title: [codex] Harden Browser Session Credential Steward boundaries

question: Should this PR establish a hard-coded Browser / Session / Credential Steward boundary in the browser and gateway runtime, or should the work be narrowed to existing generic session-boundary helpers and related canonical issues first?
rationale: The diff changes fail-closed security behavior, browser profile/session mutation policy, diagnostics, and repository automation; automation can identify blockers but cannot choose the permanent security boundary or accept the upgrade risk.

options.title: Narrow And Rebase First
options.body: Rebase onto current main, keep only the steward behavior maintainers want after comparing existing mismatch guards, pin the live-eval image, and require real behavior proof before merge.

options.title: Accept Broad Steward Boundary
options.body: Approve the hard-coded steward model as core/browser policy and require compatibility, diagnostics, and proof updates before landing.

options.title: Pause This Branch
options.body: Close or pause this broad draft and split the workflow, docs, browser guard, and gateway session hardening into smaller reviewed PRs.

recommendation.title: Narrow And Rebase First
recommendation.body: Rebase onto current main, keep only the steward behavior maintainers want after comparing existing mismatch guards, pin the live-eval image, and require real behavior proof before merge.
